address: via di San Basilio 42, Rome, 00187, Italy
bio: At lunchtime, enjoy informal dishes on the ground floor of this restaurant, while more creative gourmet cuisine is served by attentive and professional staff in the dining room on the first floor. Talented Roman chef Andrea Pasqualucci is at the helm in the kitchen, where he prepares creative and imaginative dishes. There are just a few typical Roman dishes on the menu here, and so the experience at Moma will appeal more to those keen on trying new ingredients and combinations....
